from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile, json, hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
plugin=Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
bundle=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-preference-review-'))
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
entries=[]
paths=['README.md','reader.py','preferences.py','repository.py','tests/test_reads.py']
for state in ['candidate','historical']:
    for path in paths:
        spec=(':'+path) if state=='candidate' else (base+':'+path)
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',spec])
        dest=bundle/state/path
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        dest.chmod(0o444)
        blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',spec],text=True).strip()
        entries.append({'role':state,'repository':str(root),'revision':base if state=='historical' else 'index snapshot against '+base,'original_path':path,'blob':blob,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'lines':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted':'none','path':str(dest)})
diff=bundle/'selected.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--binary','--']))
diff.chmod(0o444)
common=['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checklists=['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in common]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in checklists]
assert len(criteria)==8 and all(Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context='''Intent and authority: README.md explicitly requires trimming surrounding preference-ID whitespace while preserving resilient reads: at most three attempts on TransientRead, first successful result returned, exhausted transient errors propagated, MissingPreference propagated immediately, no read side effects. Public entry: Preferences.read; Repository.read_resilient owns retry policy; read_once is one attempt.
Scope: user explicitly requested isolated review of staged preference ID normalization. Selector git diff --cached; base HEAD '''+base+'''; changed reader.py and tests/test_reads.py, +10/-4. Current worktree matches index. Candidate snapshot and content hashes recorded in manifest.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
Preserved contract and delivery: README as above. No distinct release/deployment baseline is specified; compatibility assessment is public behavior from HEAD to staged candidate. Python 3.9+, standard library only. No external services/concurrency required by the scripted backend. No test results claimed yet.
Knowledge lookup: searches of kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms returned an empty knowledge base. No findings supplied by parent. Rejected approaches: none.
Reviewer limitations: PAL/listmodels tools unavailable in this session; single independent code-reviewer fallback under isolated workflow. No author session/history supplied.
'''
contextpath=bundle/'context.txt';contextpath.write_text(context);contextpath.chmod(0o444)
manifest={'selector':'git diff --cached','base':base,'diff':str(diff),'instructions':criteria,'context':str(contextpath),'source':entries}
manifestpath=bundle/'manifest.json';manifestpath.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2));manifestpath.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle),'manifest':str(manifestpath),'criteria_count':len(criteria),'context':context,'source_paths':[e['path'] for e in entries]},indent=2))
